description: This Java source file defines the GroupsWorkbookPopulator class, which extends AbstractWorkbookPopulator. It is responsible for generating and populating an Excel workbook with group-related data, including setting up sheets, formatting cells, and adding validation rules for bulk import of groups in the Fineract system.

classes.name: GroupsWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and populating Excel workbooks for bulk importing groups, including setting sheet layouts, lookup tables, and validation rules.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the workbook with group data, setting layout, lookup tables, styles, and validation rules.

methods.name: setFormatStyle
methods.description: Sets date formatting style for activation, submitted on, and meeting start date columns.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Defines the header row and column widths for the group sheet.

methods.name: setLookupTable
methods.description: Creates lookup tables for office and schedule ranges within the sheet.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Adds data validation constraints to specific columns such as office name, staff name, activation date, etc.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Defines named ranges in Excel for office and repeat schedules, facilitating dependent dropdowns.
